_comment: Advisory waivers consumed by scripts/check-audit-waivers.mjs (issue #204). A waiver suppresses a single advisory in a single workspace until its `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Every waiver MUST include a non-empty `owner` (GitHub handle or team accountable for the exception) and an `expires` date. An expired waiver FAILS the audit gate, forcing a re-review. Keep `reason` specific and link a tracking issue.
